title: Oven Roasted German Onion Hash
description: A savory and shaggy German dish featuring caramelized onions, this paleo-friendly recipe is perfect for a snack or side dish. It is made with vegetable oil and roasted to perfection in the oven.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the sliced onions with vegetable oil, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and paprika until they are evenly coated.
Spread the onions out in a single layer on a large baking sheet.
Roast the onions in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
After 30 minutes, increase the oven temperature to 450 degrees Fahrenheit and continue roasting for an additional 20 minutes, or until the onions are caramelized and golden brown.
Remove the onions from the oven and let them cool slightly.
Use a spatula to scrape the onions into a large serving dish or individual serving portions.
Serve the oven roasted German onion hash hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
